description: University campus buildings electrical and thermal demand and generation. is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Dorin Let (Valahia University of Targoviste). UVTgv has agreed to share data for both generation and consumption profile of their buildings. The load data is provided as one .csv per building and year with 8760 rows each one representing one hourly consumption of the building. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
